I'll write the test first. Your change to seven is already in the script, so the new test will pass straight away and prove nothing. To watch it fail, I'll temporarily put the script back to five, then restore your version.

<edit path="tests/test_rotate_logs.py">
import os
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

SCRIPT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "bin" / "rotate-logs.sh"


def test_keeps_seven_newest_gz_archives(tmp_path):
    names = [f"app-{i}.log.gz" for i in range(9)]  # index 0 is oldest
    for age, name in enumerate(names):
        archive = tmp_path / name
        archive.write_bytes(b"x")
        mtime = 1_700_000_000 + age * 60
        os.utime(archive, (mtime, mtime))

    result = subprocess.run(["sh", str(SCRIPT), str(tmp_path)])

    assert result.returncode == 0
    remaining = sorted(p.name for p in tmp_path.glob("*.gz"))
    assert remaining == sorted(names[2:])
